docs: Digital goods content: the heading, a description and an ordered list of digital goods, each with the format, the name, a line, the price as it is shown and an optional address. One object is valid in every layout (cards, rows).

description.docs: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

items.docs: the goods, in the order they are shown

id.docs: stable key of the entry (the Codex entry id)

format.docs: the format as a short pill (PDF, Figma, video course); empty: none

description.docs: one line about the good; empty: none

price.docs: the price as it is shown (990 ₽, free)

href.docs: the address of the good page; empty: no link
